notes: «ح» joins two branches; «قالا حدثنا ابن وهب» writes the rest once, so it is the shared tail

the saying is the account of a paralysed man met in the father's story («فإذا رجل مقعد ... فقال له سأحدثك حديثا»); he is unnamed and is not added; the father is the last link as a relation (rule 11: first-person narrative)
معاوية is bare in the text; the K6I claim of Mu'awiya b. Abi Sufyan is not in the text and cannot fit a transmitter of Ibn Wahb (name_facts), so it is filed as a fix

fixes.reason: K6I attaches Mu'awiya b. Abi Sufyan (d. 60 AH) to a name that the text gives only as معاوية and that transmits to Ibn Wahb (d. 197 AH), a generation later.
